vocab.cn_example: 实际上我并没有看见她，只是听到了她的声音。

vocab.definition: the act of using your teeth to cut and tear into something
vocab.example: He bit into the apple.
vocab.cn_example: 他咬了一口苹果。

vocab.definition: the land by an ocean
vocab.example: Rimini is a thriving resort on the east coast of Italy.
vocab.cn_example: 里米尼是意大利东海岸一个繁华的度假胜地。

vocab.definition: an agreement that you have with another person
vocab.example: a business deal
vocab.cn_example: 商业交易

vocab.definition: an area of land without many plants or water
vocab.example: They were lost in the desert for nine days.
vocab.cn_example: 他们在沙漠里迷路已经有9天了。

vocab.definition: it works well
vocab.cn_meaning: 能产生预期结果的；有效的
vocab.example: Although she's not officially our boss, she's in effective control of the office.
vocab.cn_example: 她虽然名义上不是我们的老板，但实际上掌管着该办事处。

vocab.definition: to look at it carefully
vocab.example: Forensic scientists are examining the wreckage for clues about the cause of the explosion.
vocab.cn_example: 法医科学家正在对残骸进行检查，希望能发现与爆炸原因有关的线索。

vocab.definition: it is not correct
vocab.example: "Three plus three is seven. True or false?" "False."
vocab.cn_example: “3加3等于7。对还是错？”“错。”

vocab.definition: you come to understand it and find an answer
vocab.cn_meaning: 弄清楚，弄明白；想出，解决
vocab.example: We could figure out the pronoun problem.
vocab.cn_example: 我们可以解决这个代词问题。

vocab.definition: something you give someone
vocab.example: a birthday/wedding gift
vocab.cn_example: 生日／结婚礼物

vocab.definition: the feeling that you get when you need to eat
vocab.example: I can't believe that that enormous meal wasn't enough to satisfy your hunger.
vocab.cn_example: 我无法相信那么一顿丰盛的饭菜都无法填饱你的肚子。

vocab.definition: to think of it in your mind
vocab.example: "Did you hear a noise?" "No, you're imagining things/No, you must have imagined it."
vocab.cn_example: “你听见什么动静了吗？”“没有，你听错了吧／没有，你一定是听错了。”

vocab.definition: a long trip
vocab.cn_meaning: （尤指乘交通工具的）旅行，行程
vocab.example: As we journeyed south, the landscape became drier and rockier.
vocab.cn_example: 我们向南旅行时，土地越来越干燥，岩石越来越多。

vocab.definition: something that is hard to understand
vocab.cn_meaning: 令人费解的情况;难题;谜
vocab.example: Scientists have been trying to solve this puzzle for years.
vocab.cn_example: 多年来科学家们一直试图解开这个谜。

vocab.definition: something is a certain way completely or very much
vocab.example: The two situations are quite different.
vocab.cn_example: 两种情况截然不同。

vocab.definition: when you want to do one thing but not the other
vocab.cn_meaning: adv. 颇，相当；宁愿，最好（would rather）；而不是；更确切地说；（用以使表达的语气婉转）有几分，有点儿；恰恰相反，而是；int. <英，旧>当然，的确（表同意）；【名】  （Rather）（英）拉瑟（人名）
vocab.example: The leaves taste rather bitter.
vocab.cn_example: 这些叶子尝起来相当苦。

vocab.definition: it is precise or exact
vocab.example: No specific allegations have yet been made about the prison officers' behaviour.
vocab.cn_example: 对于典狱官的行为，尚未作出明确的指控。

vocab.definition: a small creature with eight legs
vocab.example: We watched the spider spin its web.
vocab.cn_example: 我们看着蜘蛛织网。

vocab.definition: a short trip in which you see many sights
vocab.example: We went on a guided tour of the cathedral/museum/factory.
vocab.cn_example: 我们在导游的带领下参观了大教堂／博物馆／工厂。

vocab.definition: a journey to a certain place
vocab.example: My science teacher is such a trip - he says the most bizarre things.
vocab.cn_example: 我的科学课老师真有娱乐性，他会说一些最奇怪的事情。

vocab.definition: a group of people who play music
vocab.example: a jazz/rock band
vocab.cn_example: 爵士／摇滚乐队

vocab.definition: by the smallest amount, almost not
vocab.example: They have barely enough (= no more than what is needed) to pay the rent this month.
vocab.cn_example: 他们本月差点就付不起房租。

vocab.definition: not fun
vocab.example: She finds opera boring.
vocab.cn_example: 她觉得歌剧很乏味。

vocab.definition: to decide that an event or a request will not happen
vocab.example: They had to cancel tomorrow's game because of the bad weather.
vocab.cn_example: 因为天气太糟，他们不得不取消了明天的比赛。

vocab.definition: a short private road that leads to a person's home
vocab.example: We heard tyres coming down the gravel driveway.
vocab.cn_example: 我们听到汽车从砾石车道上开过来。

vocab.definition: waste material like unwanted or spoiled food, bottles, paper, etc.
vocab.example: Put the lid on the garbage can.
vocab.cn_example: 把盖子盖在垃圾筒上。

vocab.definition: something designed to do a certain task like play music
vocab.example: the instrument panel
vocab.cn_example: 仪表板

vocab.definition: a record of information printed with an item on each line
vocab.example: a shopping list
vocab.cn_example: 购物单

vocab.definition: the power to do impossible things
vocab.example: The group is known for its belief in witchcraft and magic.
vocab.cn_example: 这一组织以相信巫术和魔法而出名。

vocab.definition: a set of words that you send to someone
vocab.example: If I'm not there when you call, leave a message.
vocab.cn_example: 如果你打电话时我不在，就留个口信。

vocab.definition: to see it for the first time
vocab.example: I noticed a crack in the ceiling.
vocab.cn_example: 我注意到天花板上有一条裂缝。

vocab.definition: to have it
vocab.example: I own (that) I was not very happy with the group's decision.
vocab.cn_example: 我承认我对集体的决定不是很满意。

vocab.definition: to say that it will happen
vocab.example: It's still not possible to accurately predict the occurrence of earthquakes.
vocab.cn_example: 现在仍无法准确预报地震的发生。

vocab.definition: a person who teaches in college
vocab.example: Professor Stephen Hawking
vocab.cn_example: 斯蒂芬•霍金教授

vocab.definition: to go somewhere or do something very quickly
vocab.cn_meaning: （使）急速行进;（使）赶紧;（使）仓促行事;（使）急速做
vocab.example: I've been rushing (about/around) all day trying to get everything done.
vocab.cn_example: 我忙了整整一天，想把所有的事情都做完。

vocab.definition: a plan that tells you when to do things
vocab.cn_meaning: 计划表;日程安排表;进度表
vocab.example: a schedule of business expenses
vocab.cn_example: 业务开支清单

vocab.definition: to give some of it to another person
vocab.example: She's very possessive about her toys and finds it hard to share.
vocab.cn_example: 她对自己的玩具占有欲太强，很难跟别人分享。

vocab.definition: a place where actors or musicians act or sing
vocab.example: The president was extremely popular on the world stage but was disliked in his own country.
vocab.cn_example: 总统在世界舞台上极受欢迎，但在本国却不受拥戴。

vocab.definition: a lot of rain or snow
vocab.example: "Get out and never come back!" he stormed.
vocab.cn_example: “滚出去，再也不准回来！”他咆哮道。

vocab.definition: to say that something is inside another thing
vocab.example: Two thirds of Californians live within 15 miles of the coast.
vocab.cn_example: 三分之二的加利福尼亚人居住在离海岸15英里以内的地区。

vocab.definition: a serious or difficult responsibility
vocab.example: I don't want to burden you with my problems.
vocab.cn_example: 我不想拿我的困难烦扰你。

vocab.definition: to agree to something that is not exactly what you want
vocab.example: We would never compromise the safety of our passengers.
vocab.cn_example: 我们永远不会做有损乘客安全的事。

vocab.definition: to make it using skill
vocab.example: These bracelets were crafted by Native Americans.
vocab.cn_example: 这些手镯是美洲印第安人制作的。

vocab.definition: you go down head first into the water
vocab.cn_meaning: （尤指头和手臂先入水的）跳水;下潜
vocab.example: The goalkeeper made a valiant dive for the ball, but he couldn't quite get his hands on it.
vocab.cn_example: 守门员奋力一扑，但没能挡住球。

vocab.definition: they are not strong and can be damaged easily
vocab.cn_meaning: 易损坏的；易碎的；脆弱的
vocab.example: Be careful with that vase - it's very fragile.
vocab.cn_example: 拿那只花瓶要小心——它很容易碎。

vocab.definition: cut something into two parts that are the same size
vocab.example: "What's half of 96?" "48."

vocab.definition: a lack of experience of difficult or complex things in life
vocab.example: She has a child-like innocence which I find very appealing.
vocab.cn_example: 她有一种孩子般的天真，我觉得很吸引人。

vocab.definition: you go first and it follows you
vocab.cn_meaning: v. 引领，带路；通向，通往；（与……）相连，相通；领导，指挥；导致，造成；促使，使得；过（某种生活）；领先，居于首位；开牌；对（证人）进行诱询；用水砣测深；n. 领先地位；超前量，领先的距离；范例，榜样；线索；主角，扮演主角的演员；铅；铅笔芯；狗绳，牵狗带；（报纸或电台的）要闻，头条；子弹；电线，导线；导语；（投球前跑垒员的）离垒；螺距，牙距；水渠，水道；行间距；【名】 （Lead）（英）利德（人名）
vocab.example: He has gone into the lead.
vocab.cn_example: 他已处于领先地位。

vocab.definition: you are with other people
vocab.cn_meaning: （尤指事先未安排的）会面，见面
vocab.example: A chance meeting with a publisher on an airplane had launched his career.
vocab.cn_example: 飞机上与一位出版商的偶遇使他的事业开始起步。

vocab.definition: to combine them into one whole thing
vocab.example: They decided to merge the two companies into one.
vocab.cn_example: 他们决定将两家公司合并为一家。

vocab.definition: it is not too big or too small in size or amount
vocab.cn_meaning: 中等的；不过分的，适度的
vocab.example: The cabin is of moderate size - just right for a small family.
vocab.cn_example: 这间小屋中等大小——正适合一个小家庭。

vocab.definition: to exist in such a large amount that someone cannot deal with it
vocab.cn_meaning: 压垮；使不知所措；使难以承受
vocab.example: Government troops have overwhelmed the rebels and seized control of the capital.
vocab.cn_example: 政府军已击败了叛乱者，控制了首都。

vocab.definition: you give someone some money for what you get
vocab.example: Usually we ask for payment on receipt of the goods.
vocab.cn_example: 我们通常要求对方货到付款。

vocab.definition: a situation is a way of thinking about it or understanding it
vocab.example: She has extraordinary powers of perception for one so young.
vocab.cn_example: 她年纪轻轻就有着非凡的洞察力。

vocab.definition: you reach an agreement
vocab.cn_meaning: 确定;决定;解决，结束（争端等）
vocab.example: The pound rose slightly against the dollar today, then settled at $1.53.
vocab.cn_example: 英镑对美元的汇率今天略有上升，之后便停留在1.53美元的价位上。

vocab.definition: a shaking movement the body makes when someone is cold or scared
vocab.cn_meaning: （因受惊、寒冷或生病）颤栗;颤抖
vocab.example: I don't like him - he gives me the shivers.
vocab.cn_example: 我不喜欢他——他让我感到害怕。

vocab.definition: they are friendly
vocab.cn_meaning: 好交际的;善于社交的;合群的
vocab.example: Rob's very sociable - he likes parties.
vocab.cn_example: 罗布非常喜欢社交——他喜欢聚会。

vocab.definition: you go very fast
vocab.cn_meaning: （使）快速移动;（使）快速前行;加速;促进
vocab.example: I get a real thrill from speed.
vocab.cn_example: 飞速驾车会让我兴奋不已。

vocab.definition: he or she talks a lot
vocab.cn_meaning: 爱说话的，健谈的;多嘴的
vocab.example: She's a lively, talkative person.
vocab.cn_example: 她是个活泼健谈的人。

vocab.definition: it is what we expect
vocab.example: A gin and tonic for my dad, and I'll have the/my usual.
vocab.cn_example: 给我爸来杯加奎宁水的杜松子酒，我还是照旧。

vocab.definition: it is at a higher level than something else
vocab.cn_meaning: 在（或向）…上面；在（或向）…较高处
vocab.example: There's a mirror above the sink.
vocab.cn_example: 洗碗槽上方有面镜子。

vocab.definition: it is in front of it
vocab.example: The road ahead is very busy.
vocab.cn_example: 前面路上很拥挤。

vocab.definition: how much there is of something
vocab.cn_meaning: （尤指不可数事物的）数量；数额；量；总数
vocab.example: They didn't deliver the right amount of sand.
vocab.cn_example: 他们运来的沙子数量不对。

vocab.definition: a strong feeling that something is correct or true
vocab.example: His belief in God gave him hope during difficult times.
vocab.cn_example: 他对上帝的信奉使他在困境中看到了希望。

vocab.definition: the middle of it
vocab.cn_meaning: 中心，中央；（centre 的美式拼写）
vocab.example: The band's performance that night at the Seattle Center Coliseum was a letdown.
vocab.cn_example: 该乐队当晚在西雅图中心体育馆的表演令人大失所望。

vocab.definition: it happens often or there is much of it
vocab.cn_meaning: adj. 共同的，共享的；常见的，普遍的，一般的；普通的，平凡的；出于礼貌的，起码的；粗俗的，庸俗的；n. 公共用地，公地；校园公共食堂；<英，非正式>常识；（基督教教会适用于各种场合的）普通礼拜；平民
vocab.example: It's not a word in common usage.
vocab.cn_example: 这不是一个常用词。

vocab.definition: to require payment
vocab.example: My boss asked me to cost the materials for the new fence and gate.
vocab.cn_example: 老板让我计算出新围栏和大门的材料费用。

vocab.definition: to show how it is done
vocab.example: He got a job demonstrating kitchen equipment in a department store.
vocab.cn_example: 他找到一份在百货店演示厨房设备的工作。

vocab.definition: someone or something that is not the same as others
vocab.cn_meaning: 不同的，不一样的，有差别的
vocab.example: She seems to wear something different every day.
vocab.cn_example: 她似乎每天都穿不一样的衣服。

vocab.definition: a fact or thing that you use to prove something
vocab.example: The police have found no evidence of a terrorist link with the murder.
vocab.cn_example: 警方没有发现任何证据证明这起谋杀案和恐怖分子有关。

vocab.definition: the quality of being truthful or honest
vocab.example: I appreciate your honesty.
vocab.cn_example: 我很欣赏你的诚实。

vocab.definition: a phrase with a meaning different from its words
vocab.example: To "bite off more than you can chew" is an idiom that means you have tried to do something which is too difficult for you.
vocab.cn_example: “咬得比嚼得还多”是一种成语，意味着您试图做一些对您来说太难的事情。

vocab.definition: it is not controlled by something else
vocab.example: an independent enquiry/organization
vocab.cn_example: 独立调查／机构

vocab.definition: the inner part, space or side of something
vocab.example: Did you clean the inside of the car?
vocab.cn_example: 你把车内部擦干净了吗？

vocab.definition: a place to keep bad people
vocab.example: He was jailed for three years.
vocab.cn_example: 他被监禁了3年。

vocab.definition: a person who is very good at something
vocab.example: She was the victim of her circumstances rather than the master of her fate.
vocab.cn_example: 她是现实的受害者，而不是命运的主人。

vocab.definition: something you remember
vocab.example: I have vivid memories of that evening.
vocab.cn_example: 我对那晚仍记忆犹新。

vocab.definition: a part of your clothing where you can keep things
vocab.example: I'll tell them I sold it for £20, not £25, then I can pocket the rest.
vocab.cn_example: 我要告诉他们我卖了20英镑而不是25英镑，这样我就可以把余下的钱据为己有。

vocab.definition: it is right
vocab.cn_meaning: 适合的；适当的；恰当的；正确的
vocab.example: It's a suburb of Los Angeles really - I wouldn't call it Los Angeles proper.
vocab.cn_example: 这实际上是洛杉矶郊区——严格来讲我不会称其为洛杉矶。

vocab.definition: you can buy it
vocab.example: On sale at record stores now.
vocab.cn_example: 音像店目前有售。
